# Software inventory

Updated: 2026-11-09. Request: [issue #124](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/issues/124).
Initial evidence revision: `4497737721d35df1e8971d5d01e8a5727def14aa`; subsequent changes are recorded in Git.

This inventories nODD's maintained software families and directly used externals, including optional and historical tools. It is not a complete export of Spack's transitive dependency graph. Versions below are recorded observations or source pins, not a claim that this checkout has a working native runtime. No shared installation was changed or activated for this inventory.

The September node registry is historical; later campaign receipts record different Spack versions. Keep each result bound to its own environment receipt. Follow the [ACTS Spack preflight](../skills/acts-spack/SKILL.md) before native execution, then use [make doctor](../software/env/doctor.py) to record actual versions, fingerprints and datasets. Installed headers/libraries do not establish full source availability.

PR links flag recorded source or integration work, not the installer, sole author, merge status or design approval. For migrated source, consult the [source notices](../software/source/NOTICE.md). A missing PR is explicitly reported; no PR number is inferred from a file's timestamp.

## Keeping this page current

When adding, removing or changing software, update its stable component entry in [software/inventory.json](../software/inventory.json) in the same PR. Record keywords, integration, installation/use recipe, version or unknown status, evidence and related PRs. Include a new analysis environment, an optional tool and a new external used inside an existing script. Describe unexecuted plans as such.

After reviewing dependency/source-pin changes and updating component descriptions, run from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B tools/software_inventory/inventory.py refresh
python3 -B tools/software_inventory/inventory.py check
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools/software_inventory -p 'test_*.py' -v
```

`refresh` updates reviewed input fingerprints and renders this page; it does not discover installation facts or approve descriptions. Stage an intentional gitlink update before refreshing its indexed pin. Review both JSON and generated Markdown diffs. Project CI and `make check` reject uncovered code families/submodules, changed dependency/build/runtime recipes, stale source pins and stale page output. Checks run offline without initializing submodules or activating Spack.

Automatic discovery covers executable source families in `software`, `tools`, `detector`, `prototypes` and `skills`, plus dependency manifests, CMake/Make recipes and CI workflows. It excludes ignored builds, third-party gitlink contents, historical source snapshots under `logs` and publication snapshots under `docs`. New imports or tools introduced within an existing family still require author/reviewer inventory review; a matching fingerprint alone cannot establish semantic completeness.
